FlowerPainter.Commercial.plotDepth.Toolt: How deep the shop plots reach from their street or lane (whole 8 m zone cells).
FlowerPainter.Commercial.lotSize.Tooltip: How many parking aisles deep the lots are.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.lotGreen.Toolti: Planting in the parking lots: none, along the edges, or in medians between the rows.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.evShare.Tooltip: Share of parking bays with an EV charger.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.extraGreen.Tool: Plant the largest left-over piece as a small park. Off: what the lots and shops do not use is lot landscaping (islands, edges, planted strips).
FlowerPainter.Commercial.amount.Tooltip: How much of the street frontage becomes shop plots.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.lot.Tooltip: A small car park on the street, in the middle of the frontage.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.NoStreet: No existing street runs along the area: shops need one to face (it became a small park).
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.NoLot: There was no room for a parking lot.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.Fallback: The chosen layout did not fit here, so a simpler one was used.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.Pad: A shop plot here cannot be zoned; it stays a paved pad.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.Rest: Not enough street frontage for more shops; the rest is lot.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.StripMall.Descripti: A parking lot on the street with a row of shops facing it across a lane.
FlowerPainter.StripMall.Name: Strip mall
FlowerPainter.StripMall.style.Tooltip: Classic: lot in front, shops behind. Corner: lot on the corner, shops wrap it. Rear alley: shops on the street, lot behind.
FlowerPainter.StripMall.frontage.Tooltip: How much of the street the strip mall takes; it stays centred.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.ShoppingPlaza.Descr: Shops round a central court (square, market, parking or green) with a lane in between.
FlowerPainter.ShoppingPlaza.Name: Shopping plaza
FlowerPainter.ShoppingPlaza.court.Toolti: What fills the court the shops face.
FlowerPainter.ShoppingPlaza.courtWidth.T: Width of the court along the street.
FlowerPainter.ShoppingPlaza.sideLots.Too: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.OutdoorMall.Descrip: A pedestrian shopping street with shops on both sides, a plaza at its end and parking beside it.
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.Name: Outdoor mall
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip: Promenade: one pedestrian street. Grand: a wide one. Loop: a pedestrian loop with shops on both sides. Lifestyle centre: the street, plaza and green inside a ring drive, lots outside, paseos through the rows.
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.plazaSize.Tool: Size of the plaza at the end of the street (0 = none).
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.spineLength.To: Longest the pedestrian street may run into the area.
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.sideLots.Toolt: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.ShopsPark.Descripti: A park woven between shop plots, with a small car park.
FlowerPainter.ShopsPark.Name: Shops & park
FlowerPainter.ShopsPark.layout.Tooltip: How the shop plots sit between the park and the street.
FlowerPainter.ShopsPark.parkStyle.Toolti: Style of the park between the shops.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.streetShops.Too: Off: the land along the city streets is planted and every shop faces the site's own lanes and lot. On: rows of shops face the streets around the site.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.outerRow.Toolti: A band along each street round the site, a whole cell clear of the lanes. It is planted; shops grow on it only with "Street-facing shops" on.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.outerZone.Toolt: Zone of the plots facing the streets: high density for big buildings on the main frontage.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.outerDepth.Tool: How deep the plots facing the streets reach (whole 8 m cells).
FlowerPainter.OutdoorMall.playground.Too: A small playground in the green behind the plaza.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.HighStreet.Descript: A market street: two pedestrian lanes with a market, café terrace or garden between them and small shops facing it.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.Name: High street
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.centre.Tooltip: What fills the strip between the two lanes.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.lane.Tooltip: Pedestrian streets, or shared alleys cars may use.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.centreWidth.Too: Width of the market strip between the lanes.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.streetLength.To: Longest the high street may run into the area; a street at the back makes it a through street.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.grain.Tooltip: Fine: one-cell frontages (many little shops). Coarse: three cells.
FlowerPainter.HighStreet.sideLots.Toolti: Parking lots on the main street beside the shops, joined to the high street by paseos.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.RetailPark.Descript: A few big stores round one big shared car park, with pad sites on the streets.
FlowerPainter.RetailPark.Name: Retail park
FlowerPainter.RetailPark.style.Tooltip: Horseshoe: stores on three sides of the lot. Twin terraces: two rows facing each other across the lot, the road running through.
FlowerPainter.RetailPark.unit.Tooltip: How wide each store plot is along the road.
FlowerPainter.RetailPark.road.Tooltip: The service road round the lot: a small road, or an alley.
FlowerPainter.RetailPark.pads.Tooltip: Small plots on the streets beside the stores (a café, a drive-through).
FlowerPainter.Recipe.MallPark.Descriptio: A park in the middle of the block, ringed by a lane and small shops facing it; bigger shops on the streets outside.
FlowerPainter.MallPark.Name: Mall park
FlowerPainter.MallPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park in the middle.
FlowerPainter.MallPark.loop.Tooltip: The lane round the park: an alley, or a pedestrian street (car-free).
FlowerPainter.Recipe.MallDistrict.Descri: The whole block as shops: big plots on the streets, a grid of lanes inside lined with small shops, squares and courtyard gardens.
FlowerPainter.MallDistrict.Name: Mall district
FlowerPainter.MallDistrict.lanes.Tooltip: Mixed: alleys from the street, pedestrian lanes across. Alleys: cars everywhere. Pedestrian: car-free.
FlowerPainter.MallDistrict.blocks.Toolti: How far apart the lanes are: compact blocks are all shops, spacious ones keep a courtyard garden in the middle.
FlowerPainter.MallDistrict.squares.Toolt: Small squares at the central crossing of the lanes.
FlowerPainter.MallDistrict.parkingBlocks: Surface car parks mixed in among the blocks of shops: none, about one block in three, or one in two.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.entrances.Toolt: Where cars and people come in, as in the parking tool: two-way, way in, way out, driveway (a real junction), driveway in/out, footpath. Nothing joins the streets anywhere else; the drives, lots and walks are planned from these.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Reason.NeedsEnt: Place at least one entrance for cars: a two-way entrance or driveway, or one way in and one way out. Footpaths are for people only.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.NoLayout: The shops do not fit this area (too small or too thin) and no street runs along it. Draw a bigger area up to a street.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.Issue.EntranceN: Entrance {0} leads to no lane of the shops: move it to a side the drives can reach.
Entrance {0} has no street within reach: move it next to a street.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.walkways.Toolti: A tree-lined walk through the lot to the shops (with a crosswalk), a promenade through the planted frontage, and the walks in from footpath entrances.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.pocketPlaza.Too: A small paved plaza where the walk meets the shops: café tables, benches, planters, a fountain on big sites.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.bikes.Tooltip: Bike racks at the plazas, or bike paths through the frontage as well.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.foodTrucks.Tool: Food carts parked at the plazas and along the walks.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.pads.Tooltip: Small plots out by the main street for a restaurant or a bank, with planting round them.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.landscape.Toolt: Designed: groves with shrubs, flowerbeds at the drives and mulch under the trees on every left-over strip. Plain: lawn and a row of trees.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.hedges.Tooltip: A low hedge between the parking and the street.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.buildingSites.T: Dirt painted on the front of every plot, so a plot not built yet reads as a site. Painted ground is permanent.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.plotTrees.Toolt: Trees and shrubs at the back of each plot, on painted lawn. A building that grows clears what is in its way; the rest stays green.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.wornGround.Tool: Paths worn into the lawn where people cut corners, mulch under the trees, worn ground where walks meet the street. Painted ground is permanent.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.water.Tooltip: A retention pond (permanent: the ground is dug), and rain gardens of wet-ground planting along the lots.
FlowerPainter.MallPark.loopRoad.Tooltip: Parking: a road with parked cars on both sides round the park (a town square). Alley: a quiet lane.
FlowerPainter.Commercial.lotMedian.Toolt: How wide the planted strips between the rows of parking bays are: wider holds bigger trees.
